import struct
d=open('a.out','rb').read()
# parse elf64
e_shoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,40)[0]
e_shentsize=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,58)[0]
e_shnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,60)[0]
e_shstrndx=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,62)[0]
e_phoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,32)[0]
e_phentsize=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,54)[0]
e_phnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,56)[0]
secs=[]
for i in range(e_shnum):
    o=e_shoff+i*e_shentsize
    name,typ,flags,addr,off,size,link,info,align,entsize=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ',d,o)
    secs.append(dict(name=name,typ=typ,flags=flags,addr=addr,off=off,size=size,align=align,entsize=entsize))
shstr=secs[e_shstrndx]
shstrdata=d[shstr['off']:shstr['off']+shstr['size']]
def sname(n):
    e=shstrdata.find(b'\0',n); return shstrdata[n:e].decode()
for s in secs: s['sname']=sname(s['name'])
# segment words
seg={}
for i in range(e_phnum):
    o=e_phoff+i*e_phentsize
    pt,pf,po,pv,pp,pfs,pms,pa=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',d,o)
    if pt!=1: continue
    data=d[po:po+pfs]
    for j in range(0,pfs,4):
        chunk=data[j:j+4].ljust(4,b'\0')
        seg[pv+j]=struct.unpack('<I',chunk)[0]
    for j in range(pfs,pms,4):
        seg[pv+j]=0
# section words alloc
secA={}
for s in secs:
    if not (s['flags']&2): continue
    if s['typ']==8: # nobits
        data=b'\0'*s['size']
    else:
        data=d[s['off']:s['off']+s['size']]
    for j in range(0,s['size'],4):
        chunk=data[j:j+4].ljust(4,b'\0')
        secA[s['addr']+j]=struct.unpack('<I',chunk)[0]
print('seg words',len(seg),'secAlloc words',len(secA))
inter=set(seg)&set(secA)
print('intersection',len(inter),'coverage of secA by seg',len(inter)/len(secA),'coverage of seg by secA',len(inter)/len(seg))
# value mismatches in intersection
mism=[a for a in inter if seg[a]!=secA[a]]
print('mismatch in intersection',len(mism),mism[:10])
# sections included
for s in secs:
    if s['flags']&2:
        print(s['sname'],hex(s['addr']),hex(s['size']),s['typ'])
PY
